Tail holds at 20 rather than easing because Tokyo cash has opened weak, with the Nikkei 225 down 1.50% near its session low, and Stress stays at 77 with WTI at 102.42, the 10-year at 4.96% and a Wednesday FOMC decision that carries a material priced chance of a hike.

headline: Nasdaq-100 futures hold an unchanged 28,981-29,100 band at -1.14% for a third hour while Tokyo opens 1.5% lower near its session low ahead of Wednesday's FOMC
body:
A third hour of live price-path evidence keeps the constructive read intact on NQ itself while introducing a genuine cross-asset conflict. NQ is quoted at 29,052.25, down 334.75 or 1.14% against a 29,684.25 prior close, as of 20:16 EDT. The decisive point is that the day's range remains exactly 28,981.00 to 29,100.00, the same 119-point band printed in the first hour after the reopen, and price sits in its upper half. Investing.com independently shows the contract at -1.16%. Three consecutive hours without range expansion, following a retracement off the reopen low that has extended rather than failed, is the opposite of the repeated-extension-after-failed-pullback structure that would push Tail toward the blocking band.

The conflict comes from Tokyo. Japanese cash has now opened and the Nikkei 225 is at 63,053.03, down 958.31 or 1.50%, having traded from a 63,691.53 high down to a 62,984.60 low and currently sitting close to that low as of 00:12 UTC. That is an opening auction that extended rather than faded, in the index most directly exposed to semiconductor supply-chain read-through. It is meaningful evidence and it is why Tail holds at 20 rather than stepping into the low band, but it is Nikkei structure rather than NQ structure, and NQ has not broken its own reopen low. Conflicting signals of this kind raise Stress and lower conviction more than they raise the probability of the specific pathological no-retracement price path that the Tail measure describes.

The move also stays sector-specific rather than systemic. ES is at 7,620.50, down 0.51%, against NQ's 1.14%, so the Nasdaq underperforms by more than two to one, consistent with a technology and semiconductor repricing of the weekend AI-pacing story rather than broad de-risking. Cross-assets remain unaligned. WTI is at 102.42, up 2.37%, but below its 103.44 session high, and the front-month has eased rather than extended since the Hormuz talks in Salalah were postponed. Treasuries are marginally bid rather than sold, with the 10-year yield at 4.96% and the 2-year at 4.62%, both a touch lower on the day. Gold is down 0.64% in delayed futures context, which is not the behaviour of a broad flight to safety.

The underlying catalyst is unchanged and remains a narrative rather than a data shock. Anthropic's Dario Amodei argued on Saturday that the industry must pace the rate of capabilities advancement so that risk prevention can keep up, and OpenAI's Sam Altman agreed on pacing the frontier while also saying a 2026 public offering would be ill-advised. There is no new fundamental datapoint attached to either, which is precisely why a single absorbed gap is a more plausible base case than a multi-session trend, and why the highest modelled Tail in the next 24 hours is 22 at the first full US cash hour rather than anything in the blocking band.

Stress stays at 77. Crude above 100 dollars with the Hormuz blockade in place since late February, a 10-year yield within four basis points of 5%, and a Federal Reserve decision on Wednesday that prediction markets and CME FedWatch pricing have carried with a material chance of a rate increase together describe a difficult, high-volatility environment that can coexist with a contained price path. Monday's US calendar is unusually light, holding only 3-month and 6-month bill auctions at 15:30 UTC, so daytime risk is headline-driven. Confidence improves to 82 on a third hour of live NQ quotes, an observed Asian cash open, and freshly verified yields, crude and calendar detail.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding published hours were available. Tail rose steadily through the weekend from 6 at 00:00 UTC to 17 by 15:00 UTC, then stepped through 16, 17, 18, 18, 19, 21 and 22 as the Globex reopen approached and arrived, crossing into the watch band at 21:00 UTC, before easing back to 20 in the final hour as the reopen low held. The mapped state was EA_ON and green for the first 21 hours and WATCH and yellow for the final three. Stress climbed without interruption from 57 to 78 as the pre-FOMC rates and energy backdrop accumulated, easing marginally to 77 at the end. Confidence held near 86 through the weekend, stepped down to the low-to-mid 70s from 16:00 UTC as the evidence gap widened, then recovered to 78 and 80 once the reopen restored a live price path. The dominant mode was normal for 22 of the 24 hours, event/whipsaw at the reopen and mixed in the final hour.
outlookSummary: The concentrated conditional risk sits in the 01:00-03:00 UTC stretch around the Hong Kong and mainland China cash opens, the next deep liquidity pools to price the AI-pacing story after Tokyo. The specific invalidation is a decisive break of the 28,981.00 reopen low accompanied by shallow or failed pullbacks, and the forecast peaks at 21 there rather than in the block band because NQ has now absorbed three hours of trade without expanding its range. From the Asian mid-session onward the base case is continued absorption, with Tail decaying to a window low of 16 through the European afternoon. Two later checkpoints follow: the 07:00 UTC European cash open, where the forecast returns to 20, and the 13:30 UTC US cash open, where it re-enters the watch band at 21 and peaks at 22 for the first full cash hour before decaying into the 20:00 UTC close. Monday's US calendar holds only routine 3-month and 6-month bill auctions at 15:30 UTC, so residual daytime risk is headline-driven, with crude the main transmission channel while the Salalah meeting stays postponed rather than held. Stress stays in the high band across the entire window, between 71 and 78, because the FOMC decision and projections on Wednesday, crude above 100 dollars and a 10-year near 4.96% do not resolve inside it. Confidence decays gradually from 82 to 67 across the 24 hours as the live evidence anchoring the assessment ages.
